verdict.rationale: Jitsu's core model is event collection that streams data INTO the warehouse and builds Profiles from those collected events (jitsu-docs-39, jitsu-docs-53), not defining models/audiences on tables that already exist in the warehouse and activating them without re-collection. The only warehouse-query hook (ctx.getWarehouse in Functions, jitsu-docs-34/55) is a minor read API inside event-processing functions, not a reverse-ETL/audience-activation workflow on existing warehouse tables.
